newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-ENTREPRENEUR GIVES STOUTE ANOTHER BIG RACE WIN.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-ENTREPRENEUR GIVES STOUTE ANOTHER BIG RACE WIN.

text.p: Entrepreneur, trained by Michael Stoute and ridden by Michael Kinane, won the English 2,000 Guineas horse racing classic on Saturday.
It was yet another big-race success for Newmarket-based Stoute who has enjoyed great international triumphs in recent months with Singspiel and Pilsudski.
Entrepreneur, an 11-2 chance, raced up the rail and held on readily by threequarters of a length from the 100-30 favourite Revoque, the mount of John Reid.
Poteen, a 9-1 chance partnered by champion jockey Pat Eddery, took third place a further one and a half lengths away.
Entrepreneur, having his first run of the season, now goes to Epsom as the leading fancy for the English Derby.
